description: 1:1 Copy of AI generation prompt templates from dmellok/tesserae-widget-backyard-birds

master_templates.single_bird: Paint the bird in the reference photo, the {name} ({sci}), as {style}. Keep the plumage, markings, bill and proportions exactly as in the photo, {pose} alone on plain, empty paper with a clear margin all round. No other birds, no scenery, no text, no lettering, no border, no signature.
master_templates.cluster_blend: This picture is a collage of {n} birds, each painted on its own: {birds}. Repaint it as one seamless picture, {style}, with all the birds together in a single natural scene: {scene}, one continuous background, the same light and paper throughout. {fidelity} No text, no labels, no numbers, no border, no signature.

poses.perched: perched on a simple branch, the whole bird and its perch
poses.flight: in flight with its wings spread, seen from the side a little below, the whole bird

scenes.auto: the birds gathered in an oval cluster, like a Victorian vignette, on branches and foliage that join them
scenes.branch: all perched along one shared branch
scenes.tree: perched through the branches of one tree
scenes.birdbath: gathered round a stone bird bath in a garden
scenes.wire: sitting in a row along a telephone wire against the sky
scenes.feeder: gathered at and around a hanging bird feeder
scenes.meadow: on the ground and low stems of a wildflower meadow
scenes.sky: all in flight together across an open sky
scenes.wetland: among reeds and still water at the edge of a wetland
scenes.garden: in a cottage garden, on a fence, shrubs and a path

fidelity.exact: Keep every bird's species, plumage, markings, pose and size as painted, and keep each about where it is.
fidelity.free: Keep every bird's species, plumage and markings, but re-pose and move the birds freely to make the scene natural.

gould.label: Hand-coloured lithograph (Gould)
gould.prompt: a plate from a nineteenth-century natural history book: a hand-coloured lithograph in the manner of John Gould. Soft watercolour washes over fine engraved linework, plain cream paper background, generous margins

audubon.label: Watercolour after Audubon
audubon.prompt: a life-size watercolour in the manner of John James Audubon's Birds of America: a lively natural pose among a few leaves, watercolour and pastel with fine detail in the feathers, plain cream paper background

woodblock.label: Japanese woodblock print
woodblock.prompt: a Japanese kacho-e woodblock print in the manner of Ohara Koson: flat areas of colour with a fine dark keyline, a soft graded background, a single flowering branch, the texture of washi paper

engraving.label: Black-ink engraving
engraving.prompt: a black-ink copperplate engraving from a Victorian encyclopaedia of natural history: fine cross-hatching and stippling, no colour at all, plain white paper

linocut.label: Linocut
linocut.prompt: a bold linocut print in black ink with one muted colour: strong carved lines, simple shapes, a little texture from the block, plain off-white paper

grumpy.label: Grumpy (plate style)
grumpy.prompt: a hand-coloured lithograph from a nineteenth-century natural history book, soft watercolour washes over fine engraved linework on warm cream paper, of a comically plump bird: an almost perfectly round ball of feathers with a big head, a stubby tail and small feet, like a cartoon game character. Give it a very expressive, furious face: heavy dark brows of feathers slanting down over narrowed eyes, a hard glare and a determined scowl. Paint all of it with real, detailed feathers, keeping the species' true colours, markings and bill so it is still plainly that bird

sketch.label: Field sketch
sketch.prompt: a naturalist's field sketch in graphite with a light watercolour wash: loose construction lines, a few annotations of shape only, on cream sketchbook paper

anime.label: Anime
anime.prompt: a hand-drawn anime film illustration: clean confident line art, soft cel shading, large expressive eyes and gentle pastel colours, still true to the species, on plain pale paper

origami.label: Origami
origami.prompt: a flat, colourful origami illustration of the bird: folded from bright paper in bold flat planes of the species' own colours, every facet a clean flat shape with crisp straight creases drawn as fine lines, no shading, no gradients and no studio light, graphic and poster-like, on a plain pale paper background

felt.label: Needle felt
felt.prompt: a needle-felted wool figure of the bird, soft and fuzzy, in the species' true colours and markings, photographed on a plain pale background

clay.label: Clay figure
clay.prompt: a hand-sculpted plasticine figure of the bird for a stop-motion film, chunky with a slight sheen and visible thumbprints, in the species' true colours, on a plain pale background

kawaii.label: Kawaii sticker
kawaii.prompt: a cute kawaii sticker of the bird: round and chibi with a happy face, flat bright colours, a thick white die-cut border, on plain white paper

pixel.label: Pixel art
pixel.prompt: 16-bit pixel art sprite of the bird with a limited palette, crisp square pixels and no anti-aliasing, true to the species' colours, on a plain pale background

bricks.label: Brick-built
bricks.prompt: a model of the bird built from small plastic toy bricks, studs showing, in the species' colours, on a plain pale background

risograph.label: Risograph print
risograph.prompt: a risograph print in two or three overprinted spot colours, grainy texture and slight misregistration, on plain off-white paper

screenprint.label: Screen print poster
screenprint.prompt: a mid-century screen-printed nature poster: flat shapes of colour, simple bold forms and a slightly textured ink, on plain cream paper

embroidery.label: Embroidery
embroidery.prompt: satin-stitch embroidery in silk thread on plain natural linen, every feather in stitches of the species' true colours

stainedglass.label: Stained glass
stainedglass.prompt: a stained-glass panel of the bird: dark lead lines around pieces of jewel-coloured glass in the species' colours, on a plain pale background

mosaic.label: Mosaic
mosaic.prompt: a mosaic of small square tesserae of stone and glass in the species' colours, set in pale grout, on a plain pale background

papercut.label: Paper cut
papercut.prompt: a layered cut-paper collage of the bird, with sheets of coloured paper in the species' colours and soft shadows between the layers, on plain white paper

sumie.label: Ink and wash
sumie.prompt: a Japanese sumi-e ink and wash painting: a few confident brushstrokes of black ink with soft grey washes and a touch of colour, on plain rice paper

pointillism.label: Pointillism
pointillism.prompt: a pointillist painting made entirely of small dots of pure colour that blend at a distance, on plain white paper

artnouveau.label: Art Nouveau illustration
artnouveau.prompt: an Art Nouveau illustration with sinuous flowing lines, a muted palette and decorative leaves curling round the branch, on plain cream paper

watercolour.label: Modern watercolour
watercolour.prompt: a loose, airy modern watercolour with soft wet edges, a few precise details and plenty of white space, on plain white paper

charcoal.label: Charcoal
charcoal.prompt: a dramatic charcoal drawing with rich blacks, smudged soft tones and a few white chalk highlights, on plain toned paper

hats.label: Tiny hats
hats.prompt: a realistic hand-coloured lithograph in the manner of John Gould on warm cream paper, except that the bird wears a small hat that suits its personality, painted with the same care

superhero.label: Superhero
superhero.prompt: a realistic natural history painting on plain cream paper of the bird striking a heroic pose with a small flowing cape, dramatic light, plumage still true to life

portrait.label: Victorian portrait
portrait.prompt: a stiff, dignified Victorian oil portrait of the bird as a family ancestor, in a small gilt oval frame, plumage painted true to life, on plain cream paper

pirate.label: Pirate
pirate.prompt: a realistic hand-coloured lithograph in the manner of John Gould on warm cream paper, except that the bird is a pirate with an eye patch, a small tricorn hat and a cross scowl

artsandcrafts.label: Arts and Crafts (Morris)
artsandcrafts.prompt: an Arts and Crafts illustration in the manner of William Morris: the bird set among dense, repeating stylised foliage and flowers like a wallpaper or tapestry panel, flat muted earth, olive and indigo colours with a firm dark outline, on plain unbleached paper

jugendstil.label: Jugendstil
jugendstil.prompt: a Jugendstil illustration, the German Art Nouveau: squarer, more geometric ornament, a bold even outline, flat areas of muted colour, the bird framed in a decorative cartouche of stylised leaves, on plain cream paper

glasgow.label: Glasgow style
glasgow.prompt: a Glasgow style illustration in the manner of Charles Rennie Mackintosh and the Macdonald sisters: a tall elongated composition, stylised roses and fine grids, pale washed colours with a few strong dark lines and a great deal of empty space, on plain pale paper

secession.label: Vienna Secession
secession.prompt: a Vienna Secession illustration in the manner of Klimt and Moser: the bird's plumage true to life but its surroundings made of flat decorative shapes, gold, black and jewel colours, mosaic-like patterned areas, spirals and squares, on plain cream paper

deco.label: Art Deco
deco.prompt: an Art Deco illustration: stepped geometry, sunbursts and fans, the bird simplified into clean curves and chevrons, a palette of gold, black, teal and cream with flat colour and crisp edges, on plain cream paper

fairytale.label: Golden Age fairy-tale plate
fairytale.prompt: a Golden Age illustration in the manner of Arthur Rackham and Edmund Dulac: fine ink line with soft muted watercolour wash, gnarled branches and twisted roots as a frame, a faintly magical atmosphere, on plain toned paper

mucha.label: Mucha poster
mucha.prompt: an Art Nouveau poster in the manner of Alphonse Mucha: the bird in a halo roundel, a flowing ornamental border, pastel flat colour with a crisp dark outline, and empty panels where lettering would go, on plain cream paper

beardsley.label: Beardsley ink
beardsley.prompt: a black-and-white ink illustration in the manner of Aubrey Beardsley: bold sweeping lines, large flat black masses against white, ornamental dots and fine hatching, no colour at all, on plain white paper

nouveauglass.label: Nouveau stained window
nouveauglass.prompt: a Tiffany-style Art Nouveau stained-glass window of the bird: leaded curving lines around pieces of opalescent coloured glass, wisteria and dragonfly ornament, soft light through the glass, on a plain pale background

japonisme.label: Japonisme
japonisme.prompt: a Japonisme illustration, Western Art Nouveau borrowing from ukiyo-e: a flat bird on a branch, an asymmetric composition with an ornamented border and a small seal-like roundel, soft flat colours and a fine keyline, on plain cream paper

chinoiserie.label: Chinoiserie
chinoiserie.prompt: a hand-painted chinoiserie wallpaper panel: the bird on a flowering branch with delicate blossom and butterflies, soft flat colours on a pale ground, fine brushwork, on plain pale paper

persian.label: Persian miniature
persian.prompt: a Persian miniature painting: flat jewel colours, gold leaf, flattened perspective, the bird among tulips and stylised flowers under a patterned sky, with a gold and blue illuminated border, on plain cream paper

bestiary.label: Medieval bestiary
bestiary.prompt: a page from a medieval bestiary: the bird painted in red, blue and green tempera with gold leaf on a vellum ground, drawn as a manuscript illuminator would, with a vine and acanthus border, no text

byzantine.label: Byzantine icon
byzantine.prompt: a Byzantine icon panel of the bird: a burnished gold ground, a formal frontal pose with a halo-like circle behind the head, deep reds and blues in egg tempera, fine gold lines in the feathers

folkart.label: Folk art
folkart.prompt: a folk-art painting of the bird in the manner of Pennsylvania Dutch fraktur and Scandinavian rosemaling: symmetric scrolls, hearts and tulips, flat bright colours with a dark outline, on plain cream paper

harper.label: Mid-century modern (Harper)
harper.prompt: a mid-century modern illustration in the manner of Charley Harper: the bird reduced to circles, triangles and clean geometric shapes, flat colour in a handful of tones, no outlines, true to the species' markings, on plain cream paper

cigarette.label: Edwardian cigarette card
cigarette.prompt: an Edwardian cigarette card chromolithograph of the bird: a small framed picture with a decorative border, slightly faded printed inks, fine detail, and a blank panel below for the name, on plain cream card

delft.label: Delft tile
delft.prompt: a Dutch Delft tile painting of the bird: cobalt blue on white tin-glazed earthenware, the bird in a tiled square with corner ornaments, brushy blue washes and a fine crackle in the glaze
